title: T57 (Tinyana) PNC - Tzaddik Gadol's Chiddushim Elevate the Ketanim — Even Bilaam
author: Pettek Nanach

beginner.en: When a great true tzaddik reveals Torah — wondrous and awesome chiddushim — it is a benefit to ketanim be-ma'alah, lesser ones in stature, for through this the katan is elevated, and everyone runs and comes to him. Even on the sitra achara side one is elevated this way: when Hashem gave the Torah to Yisrael, all the umos came to Bilaam (Zevachim 116). Through matan Torah, Bilaam was elevated, the whole world came to him, and he stood himself on some pasuk and said to them Torah; they asked 'Hashem la-mabul yashav' (Psalms 29:10), and he stood on a pasuk and answered them 'Hashem oz' (29:11). And the same in Israel itself, with those in kedushah who do not, chas ve-shalom, come to a Bilaam-figure: when a great true tzaddik reveals chiddushim and a great commotion is made that he reveals such awesome chiddushim, then everyone gathers and comes to some lesser one and assembles to hear from him because of the rea'sh — the commotion — made through the chiddushim of the gadol; and he stands on some pasuk and says to them what he says.

intermediate.en: **K'she-tzaddik gadol amiti megaleh Torah — chiddushim nifla'im ve-nora'im — hu tovah la-ketanim be-ma'alah**, she-al-yedei zeh **nisgadel ha-katan be-ma'alah she-ha-kol ratzim u-va'im elav.** **Ve-gam ba-sitra-achara nisgadel echad al-yedei zeh** — ke-mo she-matzinu **be-Vilam**: k'she-natan Hashem yisborach et ha-Torah le-Yisrael, ba'u kol ha-umos le-Vilam (זבחים קטז.). Nimtza she-al-yedei netinas ha-Torah le-Yisrael nisgadel Bilam, u-va'u elav kol ha-olam, ve-hu amad atzmo al eizeh pasuk ve-amar la-hem Torah: she-alu **"ה' לַמַּבּוּל יָשָׁב"** (תה' כט:י), ve-hu amad al pasuk ve-heshiv la-hem **"ה' עֹז"** ve-chu' (כט:יא). **Ve-chen be-Yisrael atzman she-be-kedushah** ve-einan ba'im (chas ve-shalom) le-Vilam ve-cha-yotzei: k'she-tzaddik gadol amiti megaleh chiddushim ve-na'aseh **rea'sh gadol** she-ze megaleh chiddushim nora'im k'eilu — az **kulam miskab-tzim u-va'im le-eizeh katan be-ma'alah ve-ne'esafim etzlo lishmo'a mi-menu** — me-chamas ha-rea'sh ha-na'aseh al-yedei ha-chiddushim she-megaleh ha-tzaddik ha-gadol — ve-hu omed atzmo al eizeh pasuk ve-omer la-hem mah she-omer.

scholarly.he: [T2:57] רעש החידושים של הצדיק הגדול → גדלות גם לקטן (וגם בס"א — בלעם). זבחים קטז.. "ה' למבול ישב" (תה' כט:י), "ה' עוז" (כט:יא).
